The '''Ebruchi freighter''' was a type of attack craft used by the [[Ebruchi]] Pirates. The [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] was often heavily modified with nonstandard weapons welded to the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. The vessel typically traveled in [[Flotilla/Legends|flotillas]] consisting of up to a dozen of these ships being led by an [[Ebruchi command ship]].
